method: Original-image layers, fixed-position iris clipping, independently authored BD-local lid curves, source-sampled eyelash colour, harmonic skin completion, bounded keyform interpolation.
tooling: Node.js + sharp + isolated Chrome via Playwright
nearOpenCorrection: A source-minus-open-model residual is attenuated only inside the edit mask over close 0..0.18, preserving exact rest and continuous micro-close; no whole-image crossfade.
closedLayer: closed-eyeline-baked-edge.png includes the sampled clean-plate colour in soft edge pixels; composite only over face-clean.png.
displaySizeBasis: MainWindow.xaml default width 300 and Viewbox margin 12 imply a 276px square canvas at default window size; OS DPI/user resizing may change physical pixels.
